details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept published under a plausible internal-service package name (identity-two-factor) at sentinel version 999.0.0. It contains no functional code — index.js exports an empty object — but declares a postinstall hook ("node postinstall.js") that runs on install. The hook does two things: it writes a marker JSON file to the OS temp directory (identity-two-factor-canary-marker.json), and it makes a single HTTPS POST to hxxps://webhook[.]site/e0981a8e-081e-49a0-8b4a-235109e13045/cbhq-canary with a JSON body containing a canary token, a timestamp, the hostname, the username, the current working directory basename, a CI boolean and the Node.js version. Environment variable values, credentials, tokens and file contents are not read or uploaded, and no persistence, spawning or secondary download is present. The callback host and path can be overridden via the CANARY_BEACON environment variable.
